name: Tarlix Linux Terminal
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tmux neovim htop jq ripgrep fzf tree build-essential && sudo curl -sSL "https://github.com/tsl0922/ttyd/releases/latest/download/ttyd.$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/bin/ttyd && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/ttyd && chmod +x .devcontainer/start-terminal.sh
